sourceSentences: [0] Senna consegue ter uma rota muito segura contra Thresh
[0] A good Senna can be very hard for thresh, due to the poke and sustain stopping thresh from taking trades.
[1] 序盤は若干セナのほうが有利。 後半になるにつれ、スレッシュも固くなるし、集団戦の影響力も↑。 スキルドッジ頑張ろう。
[1] Thresh can pull Senna out of position with his Q (Death Sentence) and follow up with his E (Flay) to secure kills.
[1] He can zone Senna very well and the CC he provides is lethal!
[1] Hard Engage is very difficult for Senna.
[2] Avoid Thresh’s Death Sentence (Q) by staying behind friendly minions!
[2] Even if Death Sentence (Q) is on cooldown, don’t forget Thresh still has his Flay (E)!
[3] If get struck by Senna’s (W), use [Q] before you are rooted to go in for the kill.
[3] You can also chase the enemy until you are rooted, using [E] to pull enemies towards you the moment you are rooted.
[3] However, be careful of being punished by Senna’s (Q) too often as Senna will gain the upper hand if your health is low.
